I'd like to express my deepest gratitude to the course creators and instructors, particularly Maria Zakharchenko, for the high level of instruction!

For me, the most valuable part was practicing the correct scissor cutting technique. Before the course, it was difficult to achieve the perfect shape, but after a detailed analysis of hand mechanics, everything fell into place.

Scissor Technique: The instructors positioned my hand so that the lower blade remained stationary and only the upper blade (thumb) worked. This immediately eliminated the "ladder" in the coat and produced a perfectly even cut.

Paw Trimming ("Pillars"): I learned the technique of combing the coat upward in layers and trimming in a circle at a 45-degree angle. The paws are now neat, rounded, and dense, without any loose clumps of fur around the pads.

Head and Face Shaping: I learned how to safely use curved and thinning scissors around the eyes, correctly trim the bridge of the nose, and create smooth transitions from the cheeks to the ears. Faces turn out symmetrical and expressive.

The training helped me reduce the time spent on the final cut and gave me confidence when fixing fixed areas. Thank you for the strong foundation, the great feedback from the instructors, and the warm atmosphere during the course!
